newsitem.title: KENYA: Share index rises at Nairobi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Share index rises at Nairobi bourse.

text.p: The 20-share index rose 15.97 points to 3089.85 points at the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) on Monday on marginal gains across the board, brokers said.

"The day was fairly active with a total of 357,000 shares worth 12 million shillings (compared to 1,140,800 shares worth 31 million shillings on Friday)," said NSE Trading Operations Manager Evans Osano.
"No special lots were traded and total deals stood at 281 from 298 on Friday," Osano told Reuters.
Rea Vipingo Plantations moved 16,000 shares at stable prices of 11.20 and 11.25 from 11.20 previously while Brooke Bond dealt 407 shares at 175 and 176.

Brokers said good (1995) results in Rea Vipingo and fairly high commodity prices in Kenyan shilling terms boosted the performance of the plantations sector. Brooke Bond is a major player in Kenya's key tea and horticulture export business.

Kenya Airways gained 10 cents to 10.70 on 130,000 shares traded while Uchumi Supermarkets dealt 10,000 shares a shilling higher at 40. On the foreign investors board, Kenya Airways moved 2,134 shares at 10.55 and 10.60.
British American Tobacco (BAT) traded 8,300 shillings on the foreign investors board at 69. The stock closed at 69.50 from 68 on the ordinary floor and traded 9,602 shares.

National Bank of Kenya traded 49,000 shares at between 17.35 and 18, Barclays Bank of Kenya gained 3.0 to 113 and traded 33,000 shares while Housing Finance Company of Kenya rose to 25.50 from 24 on 8,400 shares.
Bamburi Cement gained 50 cents to 29.50 on 24,000 shares while Kenya Breweries improved further to 48 from 46.75 on 18,000 shares.
